content:
Alex: heads-up — seeing a steady upward slope in process RSS on long-session streaming tool loops (runs ~4–8h). Not an OOM yet but memory headroom drops ~30% over time on dedicated-2. Attached short dumps below. :thinking:

Alex: jemalloc stats (snapshots every hour):
```
allocated: 12.4GB -> 15.1GB over 6h
arena[0].nactive: 12345 -> 18700
active: 10.9GB -> 13.6GB
allocated_small: many tiny regions, fragmentation ratio ~1.15
retain: 1.2GB -> 2.6GB
```

Alex: pmap/RSS trend (tail):
```
12:00  rss=12.4G anon=9.8G file=2.0G
14:00  rss=13.2G anon=10.3G file=2.1G
16:00  rss=14.8G anon=11.9G file=2.3G
```

Maria: can you share the KV cache metrics? i'm wondering if pages are being pinned or if evictions aren't keeping up. fragmentation + retained arenas smells like pinned ranges. :eyes:

Alex: kv stats from the same run (every 30m):
```
kv.resident_pages: 1.2M -> 1.9M
kv.eviction_count: 420 -> 435  # very low relative to resident growth
kv.page_pin_count: spikes during tool calls, often not decremented for retries
kv.compaction_runs: 0 -> 1 (manual triggered at 5h)
```

Devin: fwiw i reproduced locally with the long-run harness. Observed a pattern in trace-kv where the batcher creates tiny transient allocations when batching windows shrink, then kernel selection flips to a different kernel path for longer seqs — which changes tensor layout and prevents page reuse (different key shapes). snippet below: 
```
[trace-kv] session=abc123 batch_id=987 alloc_page key_shape=(B=1,S=1024) -> key_shape=(B=1,S=4096)
[trace-kv] page_alloc id=0x7f9a tag=batcher temp=true
[trace-kv] page_pin id=0x7f9a by=toolcall retry=true
```

Devin: hypothesis: batching heuristics + kernel-switching cause many short-lived page variants, which keeps old variants resident because eviction policy is affinity-aware and refuses to evict pinned variants. Over long sessions that accumulates into retained memory.

Maria: good catch. i think two levers to try: force compaction at session end and relax pin lifetime for retries. also lower the eviction threshold so eviction is more aggressive for long sessions.

Sasha: scheduling a canary w/ quick config to test fixes: kv.compact_after_session=true, kv.retry_pin_ttl=2s -> (was 30s), batcher.max_wait_ms=15 (was 5). will run on dedicated-canary-4. tagging eng-oncall. :memo:

Alex: plan i've outlined — reproduce + triage steps:
1) run longsession harness (script below) for 6h with --trace-kv + --jemalloc-stats + pprof HTTP sampling enabled
2) capture hourly jemalloc snapshots + heap profiles
3) run variant A (compact_after_session) and B (relax pin/reuse heuristic) and measure resident slope (GB/h)
4) if either reduces slope by >50% push to canary and add an automatic compact sweep in cleanup path

Alex: harness command: 
```
./tools/longsession_run.sh --duration=6h --traffic=streaming-toolloop --trace-kv --jemalloc-stats --pprof-port=6060 --session-tag=longsession-2469
```

Devin: quick pprof note — use heap.alloc_objects (sampled) + wall clock RSS; we need both because sampling won't show fragmentation from retained mmapped arenas. also collect /proc/<pid>/smaps at end of run.

Maria: i'll add a quick script to call /internal/kv/compact and /internal/kv/evict?age_gt=1h at session cleanup. if that reduces retained by >1GB it's a good patch.

Sasha: canary started (id=canary-2026-03-18-01). logging enabled and deploy-bot queued config. i'll post results in this thread when the run finishes (~8h).

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: canary-2026-03-18-01 -> dedicated-canary-4 (config: kv.compact_after_session=true, kv.retry_pin_ttl=2s, batcher.max_wait_ms=15). CI: green. :rocket:

Alex: thanks — i'll attach the full heap dumps and jemalloc profiles to the perf issue (linking after i create it). if anyone wants to pair on reproducer let me know.

Maria: ping me when you open the issue, i'll add regression test in perf harness.

Devin: i'll look into a small kernel-selection fix that keeps a canonical key shape for prefix cache entries so reuse is more likely even when kernels change.

Sasha: noted. thx team. :thumbsup:
